main.description: Owner-only encrypted server-private article drafts. Authentication required; owner comes only from the authenticated DID. Never publishes drafts or images to the PDS. Responses use private, no-store and nosniff. Storage unavailable returns Unavailable. Saves use expectedRevision CAS and durable mutationId idempotency; tombstones never resurrect. Explicit Publish/Schedule remain separate actions. Lists UUIDs in ascending order, includes deletion tombstones, and uses an exclusive UUID cursor. Clients resolve unlocked cross-device conflicts by payload.updatedAt (latest edit wins); ties, tombstones, and publication/schedule claims prefer the server.
